items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 6 vs CAR (hamstring), along with Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley. DeVonta Smith is IN/cleared.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury roundup lists Barkley/Hurts/Shipley OUT; Smith IN.
items.implication: PHI thin at RB with McKee starting; pass-catchers elevated.
items.opportunity: RB volume to remaining backs; WR/TE targets with healthy top pass-catchers.

items.text: Eagles ruled out Jalen Hurts (calf/blood clot) for Sunday vs CAR; first game without him, Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Official ruling; Rapoport notes first game without Hurts.
items.implication: McKee QB with healthy top-4 pass-catchers per Levitan but thin RB.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday at CLE due to ankle injury; second straight miss.
items.why: Schefter report confirmed by ETR OUT list and Rapoport.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts again; Ravens pass game downgraded.
items.opportunity: Huntley streaming/QB2; Flowers still viable WR2 per some.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Bunch of Qs more probable: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin WRs expecting 2-WR Metcalf/Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) but 4th-string RB.
items.why: Levitan player-specific read on ETR report: practice/illness context.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean play on probables; PIT WR thinness; PHI pass-catcher stack viable.
items.opportunity: If Brown/Henderson OUT, NE WR/RB backups; Metcalf high target share; PHI WRs/TE.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Week 6 vs NE, third straight miss; AD Mitchell also OUT.
items.why: ETR lists OUT; corroborated by reports of no practice.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin) for Texans Week 6.
items.why: ETR comprehensive OUT list; multiple injury reports.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) for Chiefs Week 6 vs LAC.
items.why: ETR OUT; confirmed in injury roundups.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for other KC WRs.

items.text: Ladd McConkey IN/cleared (no designation) along with Quentin Johnston for Chargers Week 6.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter notes McConkey no designation.
items.implication: Full Chargers WR corps available vs KC.

items.text: DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty all IN/cleared for Week 6.
items.why: ETR IN section after prior uncertainty.
items.implication: Key skill players available; PHI WR elevated with Hurts out.
items.opportunity: Smith targets with McKee; Lamb/Jeanty full roles.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday vs Rams.
Matthew Berry LOVES Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage in soft matchup.
items.why: Usage you can bank on vs CHI defense.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5), Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ (RB9) for volume vs leaky run defenses; Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line.
items.why: Volume + matchups leaking vs run; role specifics.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34), Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18) due to ugly matchups and shaky QB/feed.
Berry HATES Bo Nix vs SEA (QB23), Justin Herbert @ KC (QB25), J.K. Dobbins vs SEA (RB27) for tough defenses/low totals/role issues.
items.why: Toughest pass D for Nix; low team total Herbert; run D + role for Dobbins.
